title: Vance Defends Approach to Antisemitism in Remarks to Jewish Conservatives
summary: In private remarks, Vice President JD Vance explained why he engages with some influencers accused of antisemitism. He also urged the audience to help articulate why a strong relationship with Israel is in America’s interest.
